necessary_context.content: Real vectors in R^n; (x,y)=x^T y, |x|^2=(x,x). Unless expressly stated otherwise A is symmetric positive definite. Source writes Ax=k, h=A^{-1}k, r_i=k-Ax_i. Directions are conjugate when (p_i,A p_j)=0.
necessary_context.name: Standing model and notation

necessary_context.content: §3 states termination in at most n steps in the absence of rounding-off errors; arbitrary x_0 is allowed. Stop at the first zero residual. The nonsymmetric recurrence (3:8) is a different variant and is excluded.
necessary_context.locator: §3 pp.410–412, particularly p.411 Eq(3:1a–f); §5 p.414 Eq(5:1a–f)
necessary_context.name: Exact-arithmetic scope
